bayts.text: Praise be to Allah, Who blesses the chosen Prophet, the one who prays,
— may Allah bless him and grant him peace, in the Family, the Companions and whoever befriends him —
and has also commanded the angels to bless him, increasing thereby his loftiness;
then to us He directed the address (Qurʾān 33:56), out of generosity, and made souls good.
So I rose, saying, in obedience to the command of a Beautiful One exalted above all likeness:
"O You Who command that we bless our Prophet Muḥammad, the gate of the heights,
to You (go) from me glad tidings presented in the service of him whom the Eternal has set foremost.
O Allah, bless forever and grant peace upon Your Prophet, the lamp of the learned,
our master Muḥammad, the Family and his Companions, in the present and in the final outcome.
as many as the things known to our Lord, the All-Knowing, O You Who through him have granted me the best sciences.
And bless, O All-Merciful (Ar-Raḥmān), and grant peace upon him whose precedence is well known,
our master Muḥammad, the Family and his Companions, in the present and in the final outcome.
He is the greatest sign of God, and it is he who drove compulsion toward others than me.
And bless, O Most Merciful (Ar-Raḥīm), and grant peace upon Your renowned Prophet, the banner,
our master Muḥammad, the Family and his Companions, in the present and in the final outcome.
O You Who lead to whoever blesses him once ten (blessings), that illumine his piety,
and to me You convey the glad tidings of the Decree, removing turbidity toward a direction other than mine.
O Allah, O All-Merciful, O Most Merciful, O You Who have been named "Beautiful" (Al-Jamīl) and "Benefiter" (An-Nāfiʿ),
bless with peace, without end, on my behalf, the Prophet possessed of splendour,
our master Muḥammad, the Family and his Companions, in the present and in the final outcome.
O You Who convey to whoever (blesses) ten times a hundred (blessings), by his standing, O You Who have guarded from evil deeds,
(bless) a Prophet who used to efface evil with good, and wake the blessed one from slumber.
How excellent an Intercessor! Whoever has blessed him two hundred times has obtained a thousand (blessings) surpassing (all) hosts.
He is the one whom He Who created him sent to His creatures with mercy and compassion.
He is the one who, for whoever has blessed him a thousand times, (leads) the wishes, and he is found in the Gardens.
O Allah, bless forever and grant peace upon Your Prophet, the Messenger, the ladder,
our master Muḥammad, the Family and his Companions, in the present and in the final outcome.
O You Who by his standing have accepted my pen and spared me illness and pain,
and through him have granted me, in my customs, what is hidden from the greatest of masters,
and through him have bestowed on me the Book, without adversity or reproach,
bless, O All-Merciful, perpetually, our master Muḥammad, O You Who are exalted.
O You Whose precious Book has captivated (hearts) for me, and for me has overcome all Your enemies,
and in my recitation You have folded for me all good things, at my passing and in the abodes,
and (bless) his Family and his Companions, in the present and in the final outcome, O You Who establish the states.
And bless, O Most Merciful, and grant peace upon him who is the desire of the saints and the learned,
our master Muḥammad, the Family and his Companions, in the present and in the final outcome.
O You Who have made my growing blessings fold up for me the distance of the path,
and for me have made my praises like the striving of every striver You have guided, possessed of zeal,
and for me have made all the months witnesses, together with purity.
O Allah, O All-Merciful, O Most Merciful, O You Who have been named "Generous" (Al-Karīm) and "Benefiter" (An-Nāfiʿ),
bless with a blessing that makes glad tidings everlasting, with Your peace, the best of mankind,
our master Muḥammad, the Family and his Companions, in the present and in the final outcome.
And lead today to Gabriel, the Trustworthy, from me, glad tidings that drive reproach
toward others than me, perpetually; and to all Your noble angels: truly You are the All-Hearing.
And lead glad tidings that last forever, from me, to the Companions, O You Who are worshipped.
And reward the noble people of Badr, on my behalf, with good; lead my aim to me.
And reward on my behalf the Prophets and the Messengers with good that perpetuates sugar and honey.
And have mercy on the saints, the learned and the believers, and spare them whoever has done wrong.
And make Your Book with me wherever I am, O Bestower Who has granted me "Be!" and it is.
O Allah, bless and grant peace at every moment upon Your Beloved, chief of the righteous,
our master Muḥammad, the Family and his Companions, in the present and in the final outcome.
